title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and use masks over time under social influence, information campaigns, policies, supply constraints, and disease risk, and estimate impacts on compliance and transmission.

interactions.name: disease_transmission_contact_event
interactions.description: When two persons are co-present at a location, infection may transmit with probability reduced by masks and location factors.

interactions.name: mask_protection_effect
interactions.description: Masks reduce source emission and wearer inhalation risk; combined effect modifies transmission probability.

interactions.name: peer_influence_on_adoption
interactions.description: Individuals update mask-wearing decision based on neighbors’ adoption and perceived social norms.

interactions.name: information_campaign_exposure
interactions.description: Persons receive messages from authorities and media that update risk perception and perceived benefits.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement_check
interactions.description: Locations enforce mandates; non-compliant persons may face penalties, affecting future compliance.

interactions.name: purchase_masks_from_market
interactions.description: Persons buy masks subject to price and inventory, affecting ownership and subsequent usage.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Daily fraction of the population wearing masks.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum mask adoption rate achieved and the day it occurs.

metrics.name: time_to_reach_70_percent
metrics.description: Number of days until mask adoption first reaches 70% of the population.

metrics.name: average_compliance
metrics.description: Average rate of compliance with mask mandates across locations and time.

metrics.name: infections_over_time
metrics.description: Daily and cumulative infections throughout the simulation.

metrics.name: infections_averted
metrics.description: Difference in cumulative infections compared to a no-mask counterfactual.

metrics.name: effective_reproduction_number_Re
metrics.description: Estimated time-varying effective reproduction number under current behaviors.

metrics.name: disparity_in_adoption_by_income
metrics.description: Gap or inequality index of mask adoption between income groups.

metrics.name: policy_cost
metrics.description: Aggregate cost of enforcement and subsidies minus fines collected.

metrics.name: mask_supply_utilization
metrics.description: Percentage of available mask inventory sold or distributed over time.
